name: Water Pitcher
summary: At Red Cloud Mesa, Water Pitcher carries fresh spring water from the local well to Camp Narache. Greatmother Hawkwind asks young tauren to bring it back as a lesson in humility, service, and respect for tribal elders.

sections.title: A Lesson in Humility
sections.body: Water Pitcher rests beside the well southeast of Camp Narache. Greatmother Hawkwind asks a novice to fill it and carry it to Chief Hawkwind. The chore tests their character and teaches young braves that no duty is beneath a tribal protector. Caring for the everyday needs of their kin matters as much as wielding a weapon on the hunt.

faq.q: What is the water pitcher used for?
faq.answer: Water Pitcher carries fresh well water back to Camp Narache. Hauling it across the plains tests a young adventurer’s willingness to do everyday labor for the good of the tribe.

faq.q: Where do you find the water pitcher?
faq.answer: You find Water Pitcher beside the well southeast of Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, near where Greatmother Hawkwind tends to her tasks.

faq.q: Who asks you to fetch the water pitcher?
faq.answer: Greatmother Hawkwind asks young travelers to collect Water Pitcher. Her aging legs make the trek difficult, so she asks eager youths to test their vitality and humility.

faq.q: Who receives the water pitcher once it is filled?
faq.answer: You bring the filled pitcher to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache. He sees the deed as proof that its bearer has the heart and dedication to serve the tribe.

angles.text: As a young tauren coming of age on Red Cloud Mesa, carrying Water Pitcher is an early lesson: honoring elders and helping the community are foundations of strength.
